$note: ARTICLE CONFIG (no coding needed). This file registers the study-guide articles that appear in Related Articles modules across subject pages, the /articles hub and the sitemap. Each entry needs: id (folder-style slug), title (must match the article page <title>, max 60 chars), url (the .html file at the site root), description (140-160 chars, must match the article page meta description), subjects (array of subject ids from subjects.json that this guide is about - drives which subject pages show it), categories (optional array of category folder names, e.g. 'punjab-gk' - a match ranks the guide higher on that category page), published / modified (ISO dates used in Article schema). To publish a NEW guide: 1) copy an existing article .html at the root, 2) fill in its head metadata + content, 3) add its entry here, 4) run python3 scripts/build_index.py and python3 scripts/seo_check.py. Nothing else to touch - the hub page, related modules, sitemap and service worker pick it up from this file.
